title: Steering Towards Fairness: Mitigating Political Bias in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to contrastive prompt pairs derived from the Political Compass Test (PCT) using a keyword-based scoring framework with ideologically aligned lexicons for social (progressive vs. conservative) and economic (left-leaning vs. right-leaning) axes, alongside zero-shot stance classification using an NLI model.
